missing_value_imputation: Median imputation is fitted inside each model-training fold before scaling; it supports sparse missing values in added predictors.
inner_selection: Mean Brier score across expanding, five-year forward-chaining validation blocks; tie-break by average precision, predictor count, unweighted model, then C.
threshold_selection: Maximize recall on the separate outer validation block subject to predeclared caps of 0.5 false-warning episodes and 3 false-warning months per year; tie-break by precision, fewer warnings, then higher threshold.
outer_test_policy: The model is fit on outer training only. Validation labels select the threshold only. No validation or test labels are used to refit model parameters.
calibration: No probability calibration fitted; event counts in validation folds are too small for reliable calibration.
